municipal.regionSource: Data: budget execution reports for local self-governing units (Ministry of Finance of Georgia). Regional totals include only publicly served municipal budgets: Shida Kartli and Mtskheta-Mtianeti exclude the units associated with occupied territories.
municipal.adjaraSource: Adjara’s consolidated budget combines the actual payments of its republican budget with the budgets of its six municipalities. Transfers to municipalities are deducted to avoid counting the same money twice. Functional series show only the municipalities’ classified expenditure.
municipal.countrySource: Data: budget execution reports for local self-governing units (Ministry of Finance of Georgia). The Georgia total combines {count} official municipal budget units and actual payments from Adjara’s republican budget, less transfers to municipalities. Functional series show only the municipal classification. Five authorities associated with occupied territories appear only in this aggregate; their expenditure is not presented as territorially attributable spending.
municipal.indexSource: Data: budget execution reports for local self-governing units (Ministry of Finance of Georgia). The map shows budgets per resident ({year}). The map and municipality list cover {municipalities} municipalities. The Georgia total includes {budgets} official municipal budget units plus net payments from Adjara’s republican budget, so regional totals do not add up to the country total.
